calls.event: FC Bayern München vs. 1. FC Köln
calls.method: Poisson attack/defence strength, 120-match half-life, fitted per league; draw counts as NO. Measured on 17,269 matches: our Brier 0.5892 vs bookmaker 0.5719 — this model LOSES to the closing line by 0.017 and is published with that score visible.
